ayahOccurrences.text: وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِۦ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ بِئْسَ ٱلرِّفْدُ ٱلْمَرْفُودُ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِۦ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ بِئْسَ ٱلرِّفْدُ ٱلْمَرْفُودُ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلرِّفْدُ is in the derivative form: رِفْدٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ر/ف/د   r–f–d augmentation, addition; help, support, assistance; to deputise, a king’s deputy; to choose as a leader; share, portion, tributary.

Of this root, 2 words occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
رِفْدٌ rifd and مَرْفُودٌ marfūd.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
رِفْدٌ rifd [v. n.; n.] addition, support, gift, a load

(11:99) وَأُتْبِعُوا فِى هَذِهِ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ they were pursued in this [life] by a curse and on the Day of Resurrection, too; what a foul gift to be given!
